did.abstract: The New York University School of Medicine Alumni Association supports and connects alumni of the program through career support, events, communications, and fundraising. The Records of the New York University School of Medicine Alumni Association consists of meeting minutes of the Alumni Association for the Medical Department from 1867-1897 and Volumes 1-4 of the New York University Medical Quarterly, an alumni publication.

scopecontent.head: Scope and Contents
scopecontent.p: The Records of the New York University School of Medicine Alumni Association consists of meeting minutes of the Alumni Association for the Medical Department from 1867-1897 and Volumes 1-4 of the New York University Medical Quarterly, an alumni publication.
